newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - BTPs to pull back before tackling 132.38.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - BTPs to pull back before tackling 132.38.

text.p: LIFFE September BTPs are expected to see a near term pull back to gather strength before pushing towards the historic high at 132.38 and beyond, technical analysts said.
The market has risen almost three points in the last three days and a slight pull back would help it to gather momentum, they said.

"After three days of rallying the contract could weaken a bit," said a technical analyst at an Italian bank in London. "Important resistance was broken at 131.90, 132.00 but it looks like the market is retracing a bit for some profit taking."
At 0829 GMT, September BTP futures were at 131.77, up 0.14.
In early trade the contract pushed up to a new contract high at 132.09.
"The main target is 132.38, which is the historic high," the Italian bank analyst said.
"A failure there could take us down to around 131.00, 130.90 but while we are above this area the market is positive."
On continuation charts the all time high at 132.38 was set on January 23.
"A bit of a retracement would be helpful for the contract in order to gain some momentum," he said.
The analyst said a postive triangle formation was developing on daily charts, setting a medium term upside objective of around 133.10.
Daniele Castelnuovo, analyst at Banca Euromobiliare in Milan, also expected to see some retracement in the near term.
He said the three-day rise, known as three advancing soldiers in Japanese candlestick terms, would signal resistance during this session.
"They will temporarily stop their march towards the target of around 133.00 to 134.00," he said.
September Eurolira futures were at 93.41, down 0.01.
